mapper.select: select t.id,t.name,t.detail,c.name as "categoryName",t.due_date as dueDate,t.status from task as t left join category as c on t.category_id = c.category_id order by t.id
select id,name,detail,category_id as "categoryId",due_date as "dueDate",status from task where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update task set name = #{name}, detail = #{detail}, category_id = #{categoryId}, due_date = #{dueDate}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
